pass_mark: The same marks as for the cell_2170_m80 card, unchanged since its protocol. On a discharge at a held current: voltage error at most 42 millivolts root mean square and delivered capacity within 3 percent. On a drive cycle: voltage error at most 42 millivolts root mean square, the card still running at the last sample, and the error at the last sample at most 126 millivolts.
